title: Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026 Strategy reported record $20.91 billion in Q3 2026 operating income, driven by Bitcoin’s rebound, despite declining revenue, negative year-to-date BTC yield, and continued pressure to fund preferred dividends. This post Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
